articles.title: Kommende Kalendertermine auf dem iPhone-Home-Bildschirm
articles.description: Wählen Sie ein Termin-Widget, prüfen Sie ausgewählte Kalender und fehlende Einträge. Eine leere Liste bedeutet nicht, dass Ihr Kalender leer ist.

articles.title: Ein Kalender-Countdown ergänzt Erinnerungen
articles.description: Nutzen Sie die Live Activity für kommende Termine. Prüfen Sie geänderte Startzeiten und behalten Sie Erinnerungen unabhängig vom Countdown bei.

articles.title: Event saved to the wrong calendar?
articles.description: Check the event destination, Cloud Calendars selection and Apple defaults before moving appointments or changing account settings.

articles.title: A family pickup plan with a clear handoff
articles.description: A worked family pickup plan: agree the driver, check shared access, record the meeting point and confirm one-off changes.

articles.title: All-day calendar events: dates, availability and missing widget entries
articles.description: Choose dates or timed appointments, check free/busy separately and verify multi-day ranges. Find all-day entries that do not appear in an upcoming widget.

articles.title: Show upcoming calendar events on your iPhone Home Screen
articles.description: Choose an event widget, check selected calendars and diagnose missing appointments. Understand why an empty widget is not proof of an empty calendar.

articles.title: Use a calendar Live Activity countdown without replacing alerts
articles.description: Use Cloud Calendars Live Activity for a future meeting, check stale event details and keep alerts separate from the countdown on your Lock Screen.

articles.title: Calendar information on the Lock Screen: choose the right feature
articles.description: Distinguish Live Activity from Lock Screen widgets and notification previews. Check availability, privacy and freshness before relying on a calendar glance.

articles.title: Choose a Cloud Calendars widget by its layout, not just its size
articles.description: Compare date-and-weather widgets with medium and large event lists. Choose readable content without assuming that a large widget is a complete week view.

articles.title: Use iPhone StandBy without mistaking a glance for tomorrow’s plan
articles.description: Set up iPhone StandBy, check the widgets your device offers and separate a bedside date display from a complete tomorrow agenda or a guaranteed alarm.

articles.title: Próximos eventos en la pantalla de inicio del iPhone
articles.description: Elige un widget con eventos, comprueba los calendarios seleccionados y diagnostica ausencias. Una lista vacía no demuestra que tu agenda esté libre.

articles.title: Una cuenta atrás que complementa los avisos del calendario
articles.description: Usa la actividad en directo para una cita futura, comprueba los cambios de horario y conserva los avisos independientemente de la cuenta atrás.

articles.title: Afficher les prochains rendez-vous sur l’écran d’accueil
articles.description: Choisissez un widget avec événements et vérifiez les calendriers sélectionnés. Une liste vide ne signifie pas que votre agenda est vide.

articles.title: Un compte à rebours qui complète les rappels
articles.description: Utilisez l’activité en direct pour un rendez-vous futur, vérifiez les horaires modifiés et conservez les rappels indépendamment du compte à rebours.

articles.title: I prossimi appuntamenti sulla schermata Home di iPhone
articles.description: Scegli un widget con eventi e controlla i calendari selezionati e gli appuntamenti mancanti. Una lista vuota non dimostra che l’agenda sia libera.

articles.title: Un conto alla rovescia che affianca i promemoria
articles.description: Usa l’attività in tempo reale per un appuntamento futuro, verifica gli orari modificati e mantieni gli avvisi separati dal conto alla rovescia.

articles.title: Notificaciones del calendario en iPhone: ¿faltan, no suenan o se duplican?
articles.description: Distingue avisos de eventos, ajustes de Cloud Calendars y controles del iPhone. Revisa recordatorios ausentes, silenciosos o duplicados sin borrar datos.

articles.title: Encuentra un evento antiguo: comprueba la cuenta, las fechas y los campos de búsqueda
articles.description: Una búsqueda vacía no demuestra que se haya borrado un evento. Revisa la cuenta, las fechas y los campos antes de consultar el archivo del proveedor.

articles.title: Exportar un calendario: archivos ICS, PDF y suscripciones
articles.description: ¿Necesitas un archivo de un calendario de tu iPhone? Elige ICS, PDF o una suscripción y sigue el proceso adecuado de Google, Mac u Outlook.

articles.title: Notifiche del calendario su iPhone: assenti, silenziose o duplicate?
articles.description: Distingui avvisi degli eventi, impostazioni di Cloud Calendars e controlli di iPhone. Verifica promemoria assenti, silenziosi o doppi senza eliminare dati.

articles.title: Trovare un vecchio evento: controlla account, date e campi di ricerca
articles.description: Una ricerca vuota non prova che un evento sia stato eliminato. Controlla account, date e campi cercati prima di consultare l’archivio del provider.

articles.title: Esportare un calendario: file ICS, PDF e iscrizioni
articles.description: Ti serve un file del calendario di un account su iPhone? Scegli ICS, PDF o un’iscrizione e segui la procedura adatta di Google, Mac o Outlook.

articles.title: Notificações do calendário no iPhone: ausentes, sem som ou duplicadas?
articles.description: Separe alertas de eventos, ajustes do Cloud Calendars e controles do iPhone. Verifique lembretes ausentes, sem som ou duplicados sem apagar dados.

articles.title: Encontre um evento antigo: confira a conta, as datas e os campos de busca
articles.description: Uma busca vazia não prova que um evento foi apagado. Confira a conta, as datas e os campos pesquisados antes de consultar o arquivo do provedor.

articles.title: Exportar um calendário: arquivos ICS, PDFs e assinaturas
articles.description: Precisa de um arquivo de calendário de uma conta do iPhone? Escolha ICS, PDF ou assinatura e siga o processo adequado do Google, Mac ou Outlook.
